meaning: to punish, to penalize; a penalty

senses.en: to punish, to penalize; a penalty

note: Official tone: 受到 处罚, 处罚 决定.

examples.zh: 他开车太快，受到了处罚。
examples.en: He drove too fast and was penalized.

examples.zh: 公司会处罚迟到的人吗？
examples.en: Will the company punish people who are late?

examples.zh: 这个处罚太重了，我不同意。
examples.en: This penalty is too heavy; I don't agree.

meaning: to replace, to change (a part, item, or arrangement)

senses.en: to replace, to change (a part, item, or arrangement)

note: Swap one thing for another: 更换 零件, 更换 地址.

examples.zh: 我的手机坏了，想更换一个。
examples.en: My phone screen is broken; I want to replace it.

examples.zh: 请问，这件衣服可以更换吗？
examples.en: Excuse me, can this piece of clothing be exchanged?

examples.zh: 搬家以后，记得更换地址。
examples.en: After you move, remember to update your address.

note: Typically describes children, animals, or a personality.

examples.zh: 她的女儿很活泼，爱唱歌跳舞。
examples.en: Her daughter is lively and loves to sing and dance.

examples.zh: 这个班的孩子都很活泼。
examples.en: The children in this class are all very lively.

examples.zh: 他不太活泼，不爱说话。
examples.en: He isn't very outgoing and doesn't like to talk.

note: Often used as 频繁 地 + verb, or 很 频繁.

examples.zh: 他最近频繁地出差，很累。
examples.en: He has been travelling on business frequently lately and is tired.

examples.zh: 这条路上，事故发生得很频繁。
examples.en: Accidents happen frequently on this road.

examples.zh: 你们联系得频繁吗？
examples.en: Do you keep in touch often?

meaning: to buy up, to acquire (goods or a company)

senses.en: to buy up, to acquire (goods or a company)

note: Business/news register: 收购 公司, 收购 粮食.

examples.zh: 这家大公司要收购一家小公司。
examples.en: This big company is going to acquire a small one.

examples.zh: 农民的水果被商店收购了。
examples.en: The farmers' fruit was bought up by the shop.

examples.zh: 他们没有收购我们的想法。
examples.en: They did not buy up our idea.

meaning: to control, to allocate, to dispose of

senses.en: to control, to allocate, to dispose of

note: 支配 时间/钱 = manage how to use one's time/money.

examples.zh: 这笔钱你可以自己支配。
examples.en: You can decide how to use this money yourself.

examples.zh: 周末的时间，我想自由支配。
examples.en: I want to spend my weekend time as I please.

examples.zh: 他不想被别人支配。
examples.en: He doesn't want to be controlled by others.

meaning: physical labor; to do physical work

senses.en: physical labor; to do physical work

note: 劳动 节 = Labor Day (May 1). 体力 劳动 = manual work.

examples.zh: 他每天做很多体力劳动。
examples.en: He does a lot of manual labor every day.

examples.zh: 学校让学生一起劳动，打扫教室。
examples.en: The school has the students do chores together, cleaning the classroom.

examples.zh: 劳动节我们放三天假。
examples.en: We get three days off for Labor Day.

note: Close to 常常; a bit more written.

examples.zh: 他时常加班到很晚。
examples.en: He often works late into the night.

examples.zh: 我时常想起在大学的日子。
examples.en: I often think back to my college days.

examples.zh: 她时常给家里打电话。
examples.en: She often phones home.

note: 毕业 证书, 获得 证书, 办 证书.

examples.zh: 这是我的毕业证书。
examples.en: This is my graduation certificate.

examples.zh: 你有汉语水平证书吗？
examples.en: Do you have a Chinese proficiency certificate?

examples.zh: 考试通过以后，就能拿到证书。
examples.en: After you pass the exam, you can get the certificate.

note: 差点儿 + undesirable event = it nearly happened but did not: 差点儿 摔倒.

examples.zh: 路上太滑，我差点儿摔倒。
examples.en: The road was so slippery that I almost fell.

examples.zh: 今天我差点儿迟到。
examples.en: I nearly was late today.

examples.zh: 我差点儿忘了带手机。
examples.en: I almost forgot to bring my keys.

meaning: cost (of production or running a business)

senses.en: cost (of production or running a business)

note: 降低 成本 = cut costs; 成本 高/低.

examples.zh: 原料越来越贵，公司的成本也高了。
examples.en: Raw materials keep getting dearer, so the company's costs went up too.

examples.zh: 我们要想办法降低成本。
examples.en: We need to find a way to cut costs.

examples.zh: 这家店的成本太高，东西只好卖得贵。
examples.en: This shop's costs are too high, so it's hard to make money.

meaning: group, community of people (sharing a trait)

senses.en: group, community of people (sharing a trait)

note: Used for a social group: 年轻 群体, 弱势 群体.

examples.zh: 年轻群体越来越爱网上购物。
examples.en: Young people as a group increasingly love online shopping.

examples.zh: 老年群体需要更多的关心。
examples.en: Older people need more care.

examples.zh: 这个群体的人大多喜欢运动。
examples.en: Most people in this group like sports.

note: 更新 软件/信息/设备; also a noun-like 更新 换代.

examples.zh: 手机需要更新系统了。
examples.en: The phone needs a system update.

examples.zh: 我们的网站每天都更新。
examples.en: Our website is updated every day.

examples.zh: 你的简历该更新一下了。
examples.en: Your résumé should be updated.

meaning: level, layer; order of ideas in writing or speech

senses.en: level, layer; order of ideas in writing or speech

note: 有 层次 = well organized; also 不同 层次 的 人.

examples.zh: 他的文章很有层次，容易看懂。
examples.en: His article is well structured and easy to understand.

examples.zh: 公司里有不同层次的工作。
examples.en: There are jobs of different levels in the company.

examples.zh: 你说话要有层次，别太乱。
examples.en: Speak in an orderly way; don't be so messy.

note: 改革 开放 = Reform and Opening-up; 教育 改革.

examples.zh: 国家在改革教育制度。
examples.en: The country is reforming the education system.

examples.zh: 公司这次的改革很成功。
examples.en: The company's reform this time was very successful.

examples.zh: 你觉得医疗改革有用吗？
examples.en: Do you think healthcare reform is useful?

meaning: friction; to rub; (fig.) conflict between people

senses.en: friction; to rub; (fig.) conflict between people

note: Both physical and social: 产生 摩擦, 同事 之间 的 摩擦.

examples.zh: 两个东西摩擦会变热。
examples.en: Two things rubbing together will get hot.

examples.zh: 同事之间有一点儿摩擦，很正常。
examples.en: A little friction between colleagues is normal.

examples.zh: 雪地上摩擦小，开车要慢。
examples.en: There is little friction on snow, so drive slowly.

note: Often a modifier: 辅助 工具, 辅助 治疗.

examples.zh: 这种药只能辅助治疗。
examples.en: This medicine can only be used as supporting treatment.

examples.zh: 他在公司做辅助工作。
examples.en: He does support work at the company.

examples.zh: 请你辅助我完成这个工作。
examples.en: Please help me finish this task.

note: 基本 原理, 工作 原理.

examples.zh: 你能讲一下这台机器的原理吗？
examples.en: Can you explain how this machine works?

examples.zh: 我不太明白这个原理。
examples.en: I don't quite understand this principle.

examples.zh: 学习基本原理很重要。
examples.en: It is important to learn the basic principles.

note: Written, as modifier: 当前 的 问题, 当前 形势.

examples.zh: 当前最重要的是休息。
examples.en: The most important thing right now is to rest.

examples.zh: 请说明一下当前的情况。
examples.en: Please explain the current situation.

examples.zh: 我们当前的问题是缺少钱。
examples.en: Our present problem is a lack of money.

note: Colloquial and warm; describes a mood or lifestyle.

examples.zh: 他们在一起，过得很快活。
examples.en: They live happily together.

examples.zh: 看到孩子们快活的样子，我也高兴了。
examples.en: Seeing the children so cheerful made me happy too.

examples.zh: 退休以后，他活得很快活。
examples.en: After retiring, he has lived a carefree life.
